scheme_data.description: arXiv:1507.00020 (Hirschi, Mattelaer: loop-induced in MG5_aMC) table tableParams with alpha_s = 0.118: the MG5 loop_sm model at its default restriction, massive b (m_b = y_b = 4.7) and tau (m_tau = y_tau = 1.777), alpha^-1 = 132.507 fixed with G_F and m_Z (m_W derived), m_t = y_t = 173 with Gamma_t = 0, m_H = 125; fixed widths in tree propagators at the MG5 default card values (Gamma_Z = 2.441404, Gamma_W = 2.0476, Gamma_H = 6.38233934e-03; the paper's table rounds them to 2.4414, 2.0476, 0.00638), loop propagators widthless, Feynman gauge.

normalization.convention: |A_loop|^2 summed over final and averaged over initial helicities and colours, with the final identical-particle factor; physical couplings

source: arXiv:1507.00020, section 'Benchmark results for various loop-induced Higgs production processes' (LoopInduced.tex 1036-1051): |M^(LI)|^2 = 1.3033633142042775e-12 GeV^-4 for g g > h h g g at the quoted point, summed over helicities and colours (with the identical-particle factor and initial average of MG5's standalone output), MadLoop in quadruple precision, all 17 double-precision digits stable. The point is quoted to 15 digits: momentum conservation and the mass shells hold to ~1e-12 relative, so it is a binary64 check only (carriers); its renormalisation scale is irrelevant (finite; alpha_s fixed at 0.118).
